create_pipeline_subclass: create a subclass of Pipeline that implements __init__ and __call__ for a custom ML task
implement_pipeline_call_method: implement the __call__ method in a Pipeline subclass to process inputs and return predictions
define_pipeline_task_attribute: define the task class attribute on a Pipeline subclass to identify the ML task type
raise_pipeline_exception: raise a PipelineException when a pipeline operation fails or receives invalid inputs
review_pipeline_abc: review the Pipeline abstract base class to understand required __init__ and __call__ methods
